description: iOS-specific terminology for accessibility contrast level

extensions.notes: iOS asset-catalog color sets expose separate 'Light/Dark + Increased Contrast' appearance slots (parsed here as the lightIncreased/darkIncreased ColorSet keys); both cross the same foundation contrast:"high" mode, distinguished by colorScheme.
differences: iOS has no separate 'contrast' trait independent of light/dark - increased contrast is expressed per color-scheme (lightIncreased vs. darkIncreased)
Foundation's contrast:"high" mode is orthogonal to colorScheme; this extension documents the crosswalk, not a new axis
